whySugaring.title: Why Sugaring?
whySugaring.description1: Unlike traditional waxing, sugaring uses a paste made from just three natural ingredients: sugar, lemon, and water. It adheres only to dead skin cells and hair, never to live skin.
whySugaring.description2: This ancient technique is significantly less painful and minimizes irritation, making it the premier choice for sensitive skin and expectant mothers.
whySugaring.feature1Desc: Easy cleanup with warm water, no sticky residue
whySugaring.feature2Desc: Safe for the most sensitive skin types
